issues.reason: Theme is expressly licensed for an intransitive subject undergoing 'un-powered relocation — ... drifting or dropped things', which is what a group of discrete feathers falling is; the Patient carve-out names masses, fluids, gases and precipitation ('rain fell, the reservoir drained, smoke rose, the tide receded'), and nothing in the instruction set ranks it above the dropped-things licence for discrete objects.

new_gaps: The intransitive-subject test carries two overlapping provisions with no tie-break — 'dropped things' -> Theme versus 'a mass moved by gravity' -> Patient — so discrete objects falling under gravity (feathers, leaves, stones) can be roled either way by two faithful parsers.
notes: The indefinite-triggered whenever rule, the per-occurrence Skolem feather group, Goal for 'to the base', the genitive PartOf for 'the base of the cliff' and the During link all follow the instruction set.
